Pre-release build for v0.1.1. Binaries are not code-signed. Check files against SHA256SUMS.txt. Install steps are in [docs/install.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/v0.1.1/docs/install.md).

## Changes

- Windows: the client no longer opens an extra command-line window on start ([#165](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/165)). When the client is started from Explorer, stderr output such as a failed preference save or a panic message is not shown; start it from a shell to see it.
- Linux: the client sets its window icon on X11 (`_NET_WM_ICON`), so window managers and taskbars that read only that property show the robroz icon ([#167](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/167)).

Full list in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md).

## Requirements

- Linux binaries are built on Ubuntu 22.04. The client needs glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+). The host needs glibc 2.34 or newer.

## Known issues

- None listed.

## 中文

v0.1.1 预发布版本。二进制文件没有代码签名，下载后请用 SHA256SUMS.txt 校验。安装步骤见 [docs/install.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/v0.1.1/docs/install.md)。

### 更新内容

- Windows：客户端启动时不再多弹一个命令行窗口（[#165](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/165)）。从资源管理器双击启动时，stderr 输出（例如保存偏好失败、panic 信息）不会显示；要看这些输出，请从命令行启动。
- Linux：客户端在 X11 上设置了窗口图标（`_NET_WM_ICON`），只读这个属性的窗口管理器和任务栏现在也能显示 robroz 图标（[#167](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/167)）。

完整列表见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md)。

### 系统要求

- Linux 版本在 Ubuntu 22.04 上构建。客户端需要 glibc 2.35 或更高（Ubuntu 22.04+、Debian 12+），host 需要 glibc 2.34 或更高。

### 已知问题

- 暂无。
